sources.details.matmul_initial_read_gbs: Observed lower bound on logical GM read service, GB/s, from separate 950PR Cast/Sigmoid CA windows (matmul_supply parameter set). Used only for capacity-bounded initial operand read credit. Includes cache service; physical HBM bandwidth is configured separately.
sources.frequency_ghz,core_counts,capacity,buffe: CANN 9.2.1 aarch64-linux/data/platform_config/Ascend950PR_957b.ini, SHA256 afa39753ab256048cc190060b1fcc8ed73c5b086f93563f2a73560a2870a8da0. Capacity in decimal GB computed from memory_size bytes.
sources.cube_tops,vector_tops: Huawei 950 NPU architecture white paper table 3-1, matched by core count. Cube 16=BF16/FP16, 8=FP8/INT8, 4=MXFP4. Vector 32=FP32, 16=FP16/BF16, 8=INT8. Unquoted formats are unknown (null). TF32 is distinct from strict FP32.
sources.hbm_bandwidth_gbs: PR 112 GiB SKU tier inferred from package memory_size and spec table; bandwidth not independently measured, white paper table 3-1, GB/s decimal.
sources.details.quant_*: v0.19 stage calibration from archived Ascend950PR_957b official CA. Earliest payload issue conditioned on single tile vs pipelined, response cycles and SIMD entry/exit clocks. quant_loop_work_ops is the common DT stage slope converted to peak-equivalent operations. These prices also include simulator dispatch behaviour.
v0.19 paired RMSNorm isolated first launches in CANN 9.2.1. Seven archived v0.17/v0.18 DT/PR same-partition, identical-binary shapes. Median PR minus DT relative to DT phase price: exclusive terminal-AIV SCALAR -353 cycles; earliest input DMA issue -194 cycles at 1.65 GHz. Simulator and kernel dependent; no PR whole-window fit.
